title: Topological String Blowup Equations via Stable Pairs
summary: The blowup equations of Huang, Sun and Wang are bilinear relations satisfied by the refined topological string partition function of a local Calabi--Yau 3-fold. We prove the blowup equations for the local Hirzebruch surfaces \(\operatorname{Tot}_{\mathbb F_\ell}K_{\mathbb F_\ell}\), \(0\leq\ell\leq2\), as identities of torus-equivariant symmetrized \(K\)-theoretic stable pair invariants; for \(\ell=2\) the invariants are localized indices.
